title: Mediterranean Blue Shower Squeegee, 20-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass W/ Mounting Hook, Traditional, Allied Brass
description: Shower squeegee for bathroom glass, 20 inches (20-inch, 20in) wall mount / wall-mounted design with decorative mounting hook to store the squeegee on the wall in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. Use this shower squeegee to clear water from shower doors, tile, and mirrors to help prevent water spots. Solid brass construction with a smooth handle; traditional style to match traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures. Includes squeegee, blade, mounting hook, and all installation hardware; the squeegee blade can be easily replaced. Product dimensions: 10 x 15 x 10 in (LxHxW). Weight capacity: 2 lb. Designer lifetime finish options for corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Limited lifetime warranty.
